title: Kitchen Surprise
description: A surreal composite image showing two women in a retro 1970s kitchen, one in a blue dress and glasses and the other in an orange dress and headscarf, standing in front of a vintage television. Overlaid on the left is a large blue ink drawing of a cartoonish bald head with wide eyes and an open mouth on spiral notebook paper.
prompt: A surreal composite scene of two middle-aged women standing in a 1970s style kitchen, one wearing glasses and a light blue dress, the other in an orange patterned dress and pink headscarf, both looking at a vintage beige CRT television. A large blue ink sketch of a cartoon bald head with big eyes and open mouth drawn on spiral notebook paper is overlaid on the left side with radiating lines, warm overhead lamp lighting, uncanny atmosphere.
